inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: One caregiver with a provisional background check was obseved alone with children. This was corrected when the caregiver was removed from the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired: Items in the first aid kit were observed to be expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired (26 TAC §746.4003(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): Three out of four staff files were observed to be missing A Pre-Employment Affidavit for Applicants for Employment at Certain Child Care Operations (Form 2912). One of four staff files was observed to have the incomplete form in the file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: One staff file was observed to only have 1.25 hours of the 24 required annual hours for their annual training year of February 2025 to February 2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Suspension and Expulsion: Detailed information regarding suspension and expulsion of children was not included in the parent handbook.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Suspension and Expulsion (26 TAC §746.501(a)(8))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: The parent handbook did not include information regarding parent rights.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))

occurrences.finding: Sanitize Tables Tops, Furniture and Similar Equipment: The diaper changing table was not sanitized properly before another child was placed on the table. This was corrected when the caregiver sanitized the table after changing the second diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitize Tables Tops, Furniture and Similar Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407(11))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: One student file did not include the completed Authorization to obtain emergency medical care and to transport the child for emergency medical treatment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Fire Inspection: A copy of the most recent fire inspection report was not available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5103)

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: A caregiver was oberved changing diapers and not washing her hands before changing the next child. This was corrected when caregiver washed her hands after changing the second child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: A staff file was observed missing the training for understanding building and physical premises safety.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Two student files were observed to need updated immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The director was observed missing the training for understanding building and physical premises safety.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children: A water table on the playground was observed full of water and accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement: One student file was missing a health statement signed by their physician or parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement (26 TAC §746.611(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A child was observed not washing hands after a diaper change. This was corrected when caregiver took children to the restroom to wash hands after changing a second child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Two student files did not include the name, address, and telephone number of another responsible individual (friend or relative) who should be contacted in an emergency when the parent cannot be reached.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect: Information was missing from the parent handbook regarding this topic including required annual training for employees, methods for increasing employee and parent awareness of issues regarding child abuse and neglect, methods for increasing employee and parent awareness of prevention techniques, strategies for coordination between the center and appropriate community organizations, and actions that the parent of a child who is a victim of abuse or neglect should take to   obtain assistance and intervention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect (26 TAC §746.501(a)(26))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: Person with a provisional background check is not following the conditions listed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: One caregiver did not have the required transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A torn and broken tent was observed on the playground.     Note: A photo was taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: The caregiver provided the incorrect number of children responsible for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Never Allow Toddlers to Sleep or Walk With Bottles and Training Cups: An 18 month old was observed sleeping on a cot with a training cup.    Note: A photo was taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Never Allow Toddlers to Sleep or Walk With Bottles and Training Cups (26 TAC §746.2505(4)(C))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: The caregiver provided the incorrect number of children responsible for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2024 data revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2024 by January 15, 2025, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: Two children did not have food allergy plans for their food allergies. One child had a food preference labelled as an allergy in their records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Hand-washing Sink in Diaper Changing Area: The water bottle for the  portable sink in the diaper changing area was empty.    This was corrected when the director moved the changing table into the restoom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Hand-washing Sink in Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3503(d))

occurrences.finding: Required Postings-Child's Food Allergies: The operation did not have the children's allergies posted in the classroom or the kitchen.    This was corrected when the owner posted the allergies in the kitchen and classroom while I was present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Postings-Child's Food Allergies (26 TAC §746.401(10))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: One caregiver did not have the required First aid and rescue breathing certification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: The operation did not have proof of a fire marshal inspection within the last year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Emergency and evacuation relocation diagram: The classrooms did not have evacuation maps posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Emergency and evacuation relocation diagram (26 TAC §746.401(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children: A bowl shaped piece of playground equipment was observed full of approximately five inches of rainwater.    This was corrected when the director emptied the water and turned the equipment upside down so that it could not accumulate water in the future.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The red posts on the playground had excessively chipping paint and the bolts on the playscape were loose.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children: Children's allergy medication was stored in the toddler room within reach of children.    This was corrected when the caregiver in charge moved the medication to the office.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3807(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2023 data, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2023 by January 15, 2024, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: One caregiver was left in charge of infants and five year olds in rooms separated by furniture during nap.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Three children were missing health statements from their files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Waterproof, Washable Mattress: One mattress in infant crib was observed torn on both sides of the mattress.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Waterproof, Washable Mattress (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary: Lunch trays were observed with food on them uncovered for an hour during the inspection. This was corrected during inspection when the food was observed being covered.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary (26 TAC §746.3317)

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: The transportation vehicle binder did not have Emergency Medical Transport and Treatment Authorization forms for the children.    This was corrected when the director printed out the forms and placed them in the binder.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: The changing table in the toddler room had multiple tears in the outer plastic, exposing the absorbant foam inside.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Sippy cups were observed not labeled properly during the inspection. This was corrected when the caregiver was observed labeling the cups with the children first name and first initial of the last name.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Set Up During Other Activities: Cots were observed placed on floor in the same activity place where children were eatiing. This was corrected during inspection when the caregiver was observed stacking the cots until meal time was over.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Set Up During Other Activities (26 TAC §746.2909(2))
